caption: Replying to @Milk&Honey Esthetics  Out of all of the ones I’ve tried, this ILSO product is of my favorite desincrustation solutions! I want to emphasize that how you prep for extractions matters just as much as how you perform them. If you’re squeezing harder because something won’t come out, take a step back. More pressure isn’t always the answer, and some congestion needs to wait for another appointment. We don’t need to get everything out at the expense of someone’s skin. And even though I love this solution, I don’t use it on everyone. Most of the time, I use enzymes as my prep before extractions when the skin can tolerate exfoliation and I want to avoid an alkaline desincrustation step.
